In this latest episode of The Gaza Podcast, host Hussam Tannera is joined by award-winning Palestinian journalist Shrouq Aila who discusses the disconnect in getting awarded while starving.

summary.headline: Gaza Podcast Discusses Winning Emmy Amid Famine
summary.summary: Host Hussam Tannera interviews award-winning Palestinian journalist Shrouq Aila on reporting during the Gaza conflict.
key_points: [06:46 UTC, Middle East Eye] Host Hussam Tannera hosted award-winning Palestinian journalist Shrouq Aila on the Gaza Podcast to discuss winning an Emmy while reporting amidst famine.

articles.title: Report: 26 US sites across Middle East damaged in Iranian attacks
